XBot avatar assets
==================

The avatar renderer is maintained in scripts/avatar/entry.js.
The modular artwork was supplied by the XBot owner from xbot-design-assets/avatars.
Asset preparation and provenance are recorded in avatar-parts/SOURCE.txt.
The former DiceBear / Notionists bundle and artwork are no longer included.

KaTeX 0.16.11 (MIT) and its fonts (SIL Open Font License 1.1)
----------------------------------------------------------------

Vendored unmodified in vendor/katex/ (katex.min.js, katex.min.css, fonts/*.woff2);
the full license text ships in vendor/katex/LICENSE.
